long_description: CarWoo! is the stress-free, organized way to shop multiple dealers to get a great deal on your new car.  CarWoo! was founded in 2008 by Tommy McClung and Erik Landerholm and has helped hundreds of thousands of customers buy their new car from dealerships who love making customers happy.
name: CarWoo
one_liner: The best way to buy a new car.
